title: Chapters has a menu row on every Space, and an edited chapter event loses its Network approval and queues again

source.ref: The Group handoff (2026-10-19) task A6: "Add a Chapters menu row, and reset an approval when an approved event is edited. Today Chapters is reachable only from the network home, and an edited event keeps its approval." Both were the exclusions SCAN-983 named.

detail: space.chapters is a Premium-badged link row under Your page in SPACE_MODULES, beside Plan and billing, so the Chapters area is one tap from the rail and the console on every Space. The catalog gates by function key, not plan, so the page answers by plan: a Network's owner and central admins run it as before, a Collective owner is sent to its member Spaces on Plan and billing, every other owner reads what the Network plan adds with a See plans button, and a non-manager still gets a 404 (the SCAN-983 gate is unchanged). approvalResetOnEdit (lib/collective/network-tools.ts, pure) says a decision no longer stands when an edit changes the title, start, end or place; updateEvent reads those four columns before the write and, when they changed, clearEventDecisions deletes the event's network_event_approvals rows, so the event returns to the queue instead of carrying an old yes or no. Cover art, capacity, price and copy edits keep the decision. Best effort after the save: a miss is logged, never a failed save.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const m=r('lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts');if(!/id: 'space.chapters'.*settings\/chapters/.test(m))bad.push('no Chapters menu row');const t=r('lib/collective/network-tools.ts');if(!/export function approvalResetOnEdit/.test(t))bad.push('no pure reset rule');const a=r('app/(main)/events/actions.ts');if(!/approvalResetOnEdit\(evRow, \{ title, starts_at: startsIso, ends_at: endsIso, location \}\)/.test(a)||!/clearEventDecisions\(eventId\)/.test(a))bad.push('updateEvent does not reset the decision');const p=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/chapters/page.tsx');if(!/if \(!access\) notFound\(\)/.test(p)||!/ownerBelowNetwork/.test(p))bad.push('Chapters page does not answer by plan');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-939: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
